name: Area de Conservación Guanacaste
description: Tucked into the northwest corner of Costa Rica, in Guanacaste Province, this network of protected areas shelters the best tropical dry forest between Central America and northern Mexico. It also stretches down to marine and coastal habitats. Visitors might spot Central American tapirs, mangrove hummingbirds or great green macaws among more than 7,000 plant species and 900 vertebrate species recorded here.
